description: Every other gang command, its flags as separate items (gang_help lists them all): create (V3; create --fair = fair mint; create --fly = Mint Flywheel; launch in one command with --dev-buy / --bond / --buyback / --split / --lp, several of the last three = one combined recipient, or --tax-cap <amount> = a capped recipient), mint (--ref <inviter> on a Mint Flywheel token), promote buy|status|earnings|claim|claim-pool|activate|work|sweep|bind|reclaim|release-dev (create --promote; gang_buy promoter), withdraw, claim, release, fly open-early|launch|invite, quote, list, upload-logo, bond post|topup|raise-hold|extend|status|start|report|settle|refund|burn|tx, call-bond post|status|report|settle|claim|burn|tx (bond your own buy note: gang buy, then call-bond post within 10 minutes), buyback status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep, split status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind, lp status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep|add, combo status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind|chunk, capped status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind|chunk, floor status|redeem|distribute|release|set-payee|bind (a token whose tax is kept as a treasury holders can redeem; redeem burns the tokens for good), base status|release (create --base 5|10 --base-vest 30|90|180 on GangLaunchpad 3.0 buys an opening base paid in BNB, locked until graduation, then released linearly to the creator; lost for good if it never graduates), grad-reward status|claim|settle|sweep|retry-carry|refund-request|refund-cancel|refund (create --grad-reward <seed> on GangLaunchpad 3.0: a reward pool the creator seeds for the last curve buys before graduation, split by what each spent; a curve sell takes out the entries of that wallet), countdown status|claim|settle|finalize|claim-dev (create --buy-tax --sell-tax --countdown-reward --cd-max-payout <amount> on GangLaunchpad 3.0: the creator's share of the pool tax becomes a reward the last counted pool buys of each round share when its countdown runs out; gang_buy goes through the module by default), creator-fee [--token] [--claim [--to]] (GangLaunchpad 2.0 / 3.0: 70% of the curve fee, kept for the creator), weekly [apply|withdraw] (the Gang Launch Day event; apply / withdraw preview, --yes on the user OK signs and submits), campaign [<slug>] | campaign join [<slug>] (gang.fun reward campaigns: tickets, lottery, my progress; join = the free sign-up while open, preview, --yes on the user OK signs, no tx), v3 income, version, capabilities; the flags no other tool takes (--calldata, --from, …) too. E.g. ["create","--name","My Token","--symbol","MYT","--logo","/Users/me/avatar.png"], ["bond","status","--token","0x…"]. Local files are read by this server: absolute paths, or --logo-uri <image URL>. Writes only preview, as above. execute / watch / help have their own tools.
name: gang_cli
